explanation: Backtrack over concatenation, multiplication and addition between digits. Evaluate complete candidates with multiplication before addition; the implementation copies remaining-digit slices and can prune impossible addition branches.
spaceComplexity: O(n²) live digit slices, plus O(n) operand/operator stacks
